assumptions.cryptoPrimarySample: Complete CMC published history returned at retrieval; no Alternative.me substitution.
assumptions.cryptoTarget: BTC-USD is an explicit assumed proxy for the market-wide CMC crypto signal; it is not specified by CMC and is not the whole crypto market.
assumptions.equityPrimarySample: Only rows with all six configured components (componentCount === 6).
assumptions.timing: Signal on target bar t; enter at close t+1; exit at close t+1+h. Exact signal/target date match required.
assumptions.vintage: Current downloaded histories are not point-in-time vintages; historical revisions and survivorship effects cannot be ruled out.
